fusions.name: Split Thrust
fusions.desc: Thrusts a prong at the first enemy, dealing 7 damage, then forks to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 70% of the damage. Holds 3 charges; a kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Pin Down
fusions.desc: Drives a tine through the target's armour into the ground: deals 30 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, leaves it 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds and [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Both Flanks
fusions.desc: Pulls up to 6 enemies within 7 tiles onto you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Second Road
fusions.desc: Once every 8 seconds, a failed dodge is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
